entries.key: A-Frame
entries.value: A 型架起落架

entries.key:
A-Frame
A rugged A-frame bush leg on a fat balloon tire. Built for rough fields and backcountry strips.
entries.value:
A 型架起落架
粗犷的 A 型架越野支柱，配肥厚的气球胎。专为简陋场地和偏远简易跑道而生。

entries.key: A-Frame Bare
entries.value: A 型架起落架（裸架）

entries.key:
A-Frame Bare
The A-frame bush leg stripped to a bare frame. Same rough-field grit, a little lighter.
entries.value:
A 型架起落架（裸架）
把 A 型架越野支柱剥到只剩框架。同样的野外脾气，稍微轻一点。

entries.key: Aero
entries.value: 气动整流起落架

entries.key:
Aero
A streamlined light-aircraft leg with a faired wheel pant. Low drag for slow, sporty flyers.
entries.value:
气动整流起落架
带整流轮罩的流线型轻型飞机支柱。阻力低，适合慢速运动型飞机。

entries.key: Airliner Front
entries.value: 客机前起落架

entries.key:
Airliner Front
A tall twin-wheel nose gear for airliners and large jets.
entries.value:
客机前起落架
为客机和大型喷气机准备的高大双轮前起落架。

entries.key: Airliner Rear
entries.value: 客机主起落架

entries.key:
Airliner Rear
A heavy airliner main gear riding a triple-wheel bogie. For the big birds.
entries.value:
客机主起落架
搭乘三轮转向架的重型客机主起落架。为大块头准备。

entries.key: Beefcake
entries.value: 壮硕起落架

entries.key:
Beefcake
A beefy main leg with long suspension travel and a fat tire. All muscle on rough landings.
entries.value:
壮硕起落架
粗壮的主支柱，长行程悬挂加肥厚轮胎。硬着陆全靠肌肉硬扛。

entries.key: Braced
entries.value: 支撑式前起落架

entries.key:
Braced
A braced V-frame nose gear fitted with a launch bar.
entries.value:
支撑式前起落架
带弹射杆的支撑式 V 型架前起落架。

entries.key: Curved Fuselage
entries.value: 弧形机身

entries.key:
Curved Fuselage
A procedural curvy fuselage section. Customize its shape, size, and thickness.
entries.value:
弧形机身
程序化弧形机身段。可自定义其形状、尺寸与厚度。

entries.key: Exhaust
entries.value: 排气管

entries.key:
Exhaust
A single exhaust pipe. Attach it to any engine and it emits whatever that engine is burning. Place several to build a set of headers or a collector ring — the engine splits its gas between all of them, so eight pipes each puff an eighth rather than eight times the smoke.
entries.value:
排气管
一根排气管。装到任意发动机上，它就会排出该发动机燃烧的废气。多放几根可以拼出排气歧管或集气环——发动机会把废气分配给所有排气管，所以八根管子每根只分到八分之一。

entries.key: Forged
entries.value: 锻造起落架

entries.key:
Forged
A nose leg with a solid strut.
entries.value:
锻造起落架
采用实心支柱的前起落架。

entries.key: GA Bent
entries.value: 通航弯管起落架

entries.key:
GA Bent
A small, springy cantilever strut.
entries.value:
通航弯管起落架
小巧而有弹性的悬臂支柱。

entries.key: Gear Bay
entries.value: 起落架舱

entries.key:
Gear Bay
Cuts a wheel well into your fuselage and fits doors that open and close with the landing gear. Gives retractable gear a place to tuck away.
entries.value:
起落架舱
在机身上开出一个轮舱，并配上随起落架开合的舱门。让可收放起落架有个收纳之处。

entries.key: Gearbox Large
entries.value: 大型变速箱

entries.key:
Gearbox Large
Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.
entries.value:
大型变速箱
在动力系统中传递旋转动力。可通过齿比在扭矩与转速之间做权衡，并据此调校性能。

entries.key: Gearbox Long
entries.value: 长型变速箱

entries.key:
Gearbox Long
Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.
entries.value:
长型变速箱
在动力系统中传递旋转动力。可通过齿比在扭矩与转速之间做权衡，并据此调校性能。

entries.key: Gearbox Offset
entries.value: 偏置变速箱

entries.key:
Gearbox Offset
Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.
entries.value:
偏置变速箱
在动力系统中传递旋转动力。可通过齿比在扭矩与转速之间做权衡，并据此调校性能。

entries.key: Heavy
entries.value: 重型起落架

entries.key:
Heavy
A heavy-duty main leg on a four-wheel bogie. Built to haul serious weight.
entries.value:
重型起落架
装在四轮转向架上的重型主支柱。为搬运真正的大重量而生。

entries.key: Hemisphere
entries.value: 半球体

entries.key:
Hemisphere
Sometimes you don't need a whole sphere. Sometimes you just need half of a sphere.
entries.value:
半球体
有时你不需要一整个球。有时你只需要半个球。

entries.key: Hole
entries.value: 开孔

entries.key:
Hole
Carve a customizable opening into fuselage parts to create cargo bays, bomb bays, wheel wells, and more. Only works with fuselage parts.
entries.value:
开孔
在机身类零件上挖出可自定义的开口，用来做货舱、弹舱、轮舱等等。只对机身类零件有效。

entries.key: Hollow
entries.value: 空心起落架

entries.key:
Hollow
A slightly lighter nose leg with a hollowed strut.
entries.value:
空心起落架
采用空心支柱、略微更轻的前起落架。

entries.key: Ivan
entries.value: 伊万式起落架

entries.key:
Ivan
A rugged V-frame nose leg with a long piston strut, styled after heavy Eastern-bloc jets.
entries.value:
伊万式起落架
粗犷的 V 型架前起落架，配长活塞支柱，造型源自重型东方阵营喷气机。

entries.key: Large Turboprop
entries.value: 大型涡桨发动机

entries.key:
Large Turboprop
The biggest turbine we make that still turns a propeller. Enough shaft power to demand contra-rotating props and your full attention.
entries.value:
大型涡桨发动机
我们造过的、还能带动螺旋桨的最大燃气轮机。轴功率大到必须用对转螺旋桨，也大到需要你全神贯注。

entries.key: Legacy Angled Corner
entries.value: 旧版斜角转角块

entries.key:
Legacy Angled Corner
It's a corner piece. Always find the corner pieces first when doing a puzzle. That advice really doesn't apply when building airplanes, but it's still good advice.
entries.value:
旧版斜角转角块
这是一块转角件。拼图时总要先找转角件。这条建议在造飞机时其实并不适用，但它依然是条好建议。

entries.key: Legacy Car Engine
entries.value: 旧版汽车发动机

entries.key:
Legacy Car Engine
Resizable Wheels can be linked to this engine for power. You can link a wheel to an engine by opening the Part Properties when a wheel is selected. The wheel must be somewhat close to the engine.
entries.value:
旧版汽车发动机
可调机轮可以连接到这台发动机上获取动力。选中机轮并打开零件属性面板，即可把机轮连接到发动机。机轮需要离发动机足够近。

entries.key: Legacy Cockpit
entries.value: 旧版座舱

entries.key:
Legacy Cockpit
Every plane needs at least one of these. Don't worry, it is indestructible, so your pilot will always be safe.
entries.value:
旧版座舱
每架飞机至少都需要一个。别担心，它是坚不可摧的，所以你的飞行员永远安全。

entries.key: Legacy Cockpit Angled Corner
entries.value: 旧版座舱斜角转角块

entries.key:
Legacy Cockpit Angled Corner
An angled corner piece for cockpit blocks.
entries.value:
旧版座舱斜角转角块
座舱方块的斜角转角件。

entries.key: Legacy Cockpit Block
entries.value: 旧版座舱方块

entries.key:
Legacy Cockpit Block
Modular cockpit piece for when the other cockpits just don't fit the bill.
entries.value:
旧版座舱方块
模块化座舱件，适合其他座舱都不合用的时候。

entries.key: Legacy Cockpit Corner
entries.value: 旧版座舱转角块

entries.key:
Legacy Cockpit Corner
Corner piece for the cockpit blocks.
entries.value:
旧版座舱转角块
座舱方块的转角件。

entries.key: Legacy Curved Block
entries.value: 旧版弧形方块

entries.key:
Legacy Curved Block
Basically the same thing as the Angled Block, only it's curved. The difference is purely cosmetic, which is important because you build the most beautiful airplanes.
entries.value:
旧版弧形方块
基本和斜角方块一样，只不过是弧形的。区别纯粹是外观，而这很重要，因为你造的是最漂亮的飞机。

entries.key: Legacy Curved Corner
entries.value: 旧版弧形转角块

entries.key:
Legacy Curved Corner
Just a curvy variation of the angled corner piece.
entries.value:
旧版弧形转角块
斜角转角件的弧形版本而已。

entries.key: Legacy Curved Reducer Block
entries.value: 旧版弧形过渡方块

entries.key:
Legacy Curved Reducer Block
Same as a reducer block, except it's curvy.
entries.value:
旧版弧形过渡方块
和过渡方块一样，只是变成弧形的了。

entries.key: Legacy Floating Block
entries.value: 旧版浮筒方块

entries.key:
Legacy Floating Block
These blocks float! Place them strategically around your aircraft to build floats, or in certain places of the hull to make a full-on boat plane.  They take some number-crunching to make work, so don't use more than you need or will slow the game down.
entries.value:
旧版浮筒方块
这些方块会浮起来！有策略地摆在飞机周围可以当浮筒，摆到船体某些位置就能做出水上飞机。要让它们发挥作用得算点数值，所以别用太多。

entries.key: Legacy Fuselage Block
entries.value: 旧版机身方块

entries.key:
Legacy Fuselage Block
One block to rule them all. With the Part Properties window, this block can be resized in many ways. Its edges can change shape, it can hold fuel, and it's buoyant. It takes a little getting used to, but it's worth the trouble.
entries.value:
旧版机身方块
一块顶所有。借助零件属性窗口，这个方块可以有很多种缩放方式：边缘可以改形状、可以装燃料，还自带浮力。上手需要一点时间，但绝对值得。

entries.key: Legacy Fuselage Cone
entries.value: 旧版机身鼻锥

entries.key:
Legacy Fuselage Cone
Special nose cone that works with the fuselage block.
entries.value:
旧版机身鼻锥
与机身方块配套的专用鼻锥。

entries.key: Legacy Glass Fuselage
entries.value: 旧版玻璃机身

entries.key:
Legacy Glass Fuselage
It's like the Fuselage, but it's glass! For the best glass effect, assign a material with smoothness at 90% to 100%, then set opacity to 0%. The dividing sections will also automatically hide, and smoothing is on by default for the sleekest canopy you can make!
entries.value:
旧版玻璃机身
就像机身，不过是玻璃的！想要最好的玻璃效果，请指定一个光滑度 90% 到 100% 的材质，然后把不透明度设为 0%。分隔面会自动隐藏，而且默认开启平滑。

entries.key: Legacy Historic Cockpit
entries.value: 旧版复古座舱

entries.key:
Legacy Historic Cockpit
Cockpit for those designers going for the historic look.
entries.value:
旧版复古座舱
给追求历史感的建造者准备的座舱。

entries.key: Legacy Hollow Fuselage
entries.value: 旧版空心机身

entries.key:
Legacy Hollow Fuselage
Special fuselage block that appears to be hollow, but is actually quite solid.
entries.value:
旧版空心机身
外形看起来是空心的专用机身方块，其实相当结实。

entries.key: Legacy Hollow Glass Fuselage
entries.value: 旧版空心玻璃机身

entries.key:
Legacy Hollow Glass Fuselage
It's like the Hollow Fuselage, but it's glass! For the best glass effect, assign a material with smoothness at 90% to 100%, then set opacity to 0%. The dividing sections will also automatically hide, and smoothing is on by default for the sleekest canopy you can make!
entries.value:
旧版空心玻璃机身
就像空心机身，不过是玻璃的！想要最好的玻璃效果，请指定一个光滑度 90% 到 100% 的材质，然后把不透明度设为 0%。分隔面会自动隐藏，而且默认开启平滑。

entries.key: Legacy Horizontal Stabilizer
entries.value: 旧版水平安定面

entries.key:
Legacy Horizontal Stabilizer
Wing section with elevators. These can provide control for your airplane to pitch up and down.
entries.value:
旧版水平安定面
带升降舵的翼段。能为飞机提供抬头和低头的控制。

entries.key: Legacy Long Angled Block
entries.value: 旧版长斜角方块

entries.key:
Legacy Long Angled Block
It's just a long, angled block.
entries.value:
旧版长斜角方块
就是一块长长的斜角方块。

entries.key: Legacy Nose Cone
entries.value: 旧版鼻锥

entries.key:
Legacy Nose Cone
Nose cones not only look fabulous, but they are designed to be very low drag. Its size can be changed via the menu.
entries.value:
旧版鼻锥
鼻锥不仅好看，而且设计上阻力极低。尺寸可以通过菜单调整。

entries.key: Legacy Primary Wing
entries.value: 旧版主翼

entries.key:
Legacy Primary Wing
Wing section already set up with ailerons and some fuel. Primary wings are intended to provide the main lift for your airplane and provide control to roll left and right.
entries.value:
旧版主翼
已经配好副翼和部分燃料的翼段。主翼用于为飞机提供主要升力，并提供左右滚转的控制。

entries.key: Legacy Reducer Block
entries.value: 旧版过渡方块

entries.key:
Legacy Reducer Block
Just a block that goes from 2 to 1. Or if you are a glass-is-half-full kind of person, you could say it goes from 1 to 2. An expander.
entries.value:
旧版过渡方块
就是一块从 2 变 1 的方块。如果你是乐观派，也可以说它从 1 变成 2——一个扩张件。

entries.key: Legacy Resizable Wheel
entries.value: 旧版可调机轮

entries.key:
Legacy Resizable Wheel
Wheels that can be reshaped and resized to whatever suits your fancy. They can also be powered by linking them to a Car Engine via the Part Properties panel.
entries.value:
旧版可调机轮
可以任意改形、改尺寸的机轮。还能在零件属性面板里把它连接到汽车发动机上获取动力。

entries.key: Legacy Riser Block
entries.value: 旧版增高方块

entries.key:
Legacy Riser Block
Sometimes you want a block to be a little higher than other blocks.
entries.value:
旧版增高方块
有时候你希望某块方块比旁边的方块高一点。

entries.key: Legacy Rocket
entries.value: 旧版火箭

entries.key:
Legacy Rocket
A single 2.75-inch rocket, can be very effective against ground targets, as long as the pilot has the skills.
entries.value:
旧版火箭
一枚 2.75 英寸火箭弹，只要飞行员有技术，对付地面目标非常有效。

entries.key: Legacy Sleek Cockpit
entries.value: 旧版流线座舱

entries.key:
Legacy Sleek Cockpit
Just a cockpit that is a bit sleeker.
entries.value:
旧版流线座舱
就是一款稍微流线一点的座舱。

entries.key: Legacy Structural Wing
entries.value: 旧版结构翼

entries.key:
Legacy Structural Wing
Stronger than a normal wing and it does provide lift, but it cannot have control surfaces. Also, it's heavier.
entries.value:
旧版结构翼
比普通机翼更结实，也确实能提供升力，但不能安装控制面。而且它更重。

entries.key: Legacy Vertical Stabilizer
entries.value: 旧版垂直安定面

entries.key:
Legacy Vertical Stabilizer
Wing section with a rudder. Vertical stabilizers help to keep the airplane from unwanted drifting to the left or right.
entries.value:
旧版垂直安定面
带方向舵的翼段。垂直安定面能防止飞机不受控地向左或向右偏航。

entries.key: Lever
entries.value: 杠杆式起落架

entries.key:
Lever
A lever-action main leg with long suspension travel for soft, springy touchdowns.
entries.value:
杠杆式起落架
杠杆式主支柱，悬挂行程长，着陆柔和有弹性。

entries.key: Medium Turboprop
entries.value: 中型涡桨发动机

entries.key:
Medium Turboprop
A workhorse gas turbine that holds constant RPM while the propeller does the talking. Bolt four onto a big wing and go haul something.
entries.value:
中型涡桨发动机
勤恳耐用的燃气轮机，转速恒定，全凭螺旋桨说话。往大机翼上栓四台，就能去拉货了。

entries.key: Small Turboprop
entries.value: 小型涡桨发动机

entries.key:
Small Turboprop
A compact gas turbine that drives the powertrain through a reduction gearbox.
entries.value:
小型涡桨发动机
紧凑的燃气轮机，通过减速变速箱驱动动力系统。

entries.key: Sphere
entries.value: 球体

entries.key:
Sphere
A ball is the most wonderful toy of all.
entries.value:
球体
球是所有玩具里最棒的那一个。

entries.key: Stout
entries.value: 矮壮起落架

entries.key:
Stout
A short, stout main leg on a four-wheel bogie. Squat and strong for heavy loads.
entries.value:
矮壮起落架
装在四轮转向架上的短粗主支柱。矮而结实，专负重载。

entries.key: Structural Panel
entries.value: 结构板

entries.key:
Structural Panel
It may look like a wing, but it has no wing physics simulation. These are good for designs which may have previously used many wings for aesthetic purposes. Those designs will run a little faster with these, since they don't take as much processing power as wings.
entries.value:
结构板
看起来像机翼，但没有机翼的物理模拟。适合给那些以前为了美观堆了很多机翼的设计使用。换成它之后，这些设计会跑得更快一些，因为它没有机翼物理开销。

entries.key: Trailing Link
entries.value: 拖曳臂起落架

entries.key:
Trailing Link
A trailing-link main leg whose linkage soaks up bumps for smooth landings.
entries.value:
拖曳臂起落架
拖曳臂式主支柱，连杆能吸收颠簸，着陆更平稳。

entries.key: Tripod
entries.value: 三脚架起落架

entries.key:
Tripod
A tripod-braced main leg with a scissor strut. A stable, fighter-style mount.
entries.value:
三脚架起落架
三脚架支撑的主支柱，配剪式支柱。稳定可靠，战斗机风格。

entries.key: VTOL Inlet
entries.value: VTOL 进气口

entries.key:
VTOL Inlet
Large inlet that can suck in enough air for any jet engine. It works better when placed near the front where the air is less turbulent.
entries.value:
VTOL 进气口
大型进气口，能为任何喷气发动机吸入足够空气。放在机头附近、气流更平稳的位置效果更好。

entries.key: VTOL Slim Inlet
entries.value: VTOL 细型进气口

entries.key:
VTOL Slim Inlet
Inlets help suck air in so jet engines can breathe. Most engines will need at least two of these slim inlets.
entries.value:
VTOL 细型进气口
进气口负责吸入空气，让喷气发动机能顺畅呼吸。大多数发动机至少需要两个这种细型进气口。

entries.key: Wheel Assembly
entries.value: 轮组总成

entries.key:
Wheel Assembly
Multi-wheel assembly. Pick a style for the wheel layout (single, dual, quad, …), then a tire and rim that gets applied to every wheel in the assembly. Attaches directly to the body for a fixed mount, or to a gear leg to retract.
entries.value:
轮组总成
多轮机轮总成。先选择轮位布局样式（单轮、双轮、四轮……），再选一套应用到总成中每个轮子的轮胎与轮辋。可直接固定在机身上，也可装到起落架支柱上。

entries.key: Window
entries.value: 窗户

entries.key:
Window
Install customizable window into any fuselage part. Only works with fuselage parts.
entries.value:
窗户
在任意机身类零件上安装可自定义的窗户。只对机身类零件有效。

entries.key: Wing
entries.value: 翼载起落架

entries.key:
Wing
A compact wing-mounted main leg that folds up thin, perfect for tucking under slim wings.
entries.value:
翼载起落架
紧凑的翼下主起落架，收起后很薄，特别适合塞进细薄的机翼下方。
